arStrings.szText:
While {c_important}Soulrift{/c} is active, you are {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} and gain {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%+|]{/c} increased Movement Speed per absorbed soul, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_2*Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c}.

This lasts for {c_number}5{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.
